scope: Entire managed inspection VS configuration adapter reconstruction; native general parser not established

findings.fact: Cache invalidation clears project options, sanitize, directory-exists, unavailable-file-tool, makefile settings and project-file caches, then increments generation under shared lock.
Every ItemPropertyChange2 clears caches; SomethingChanged only for active configuration and listed property names.
Makefile cache key projectPath+NUL+configuration; compute outside lock, admit only unchanged generation.

Microsoft.Build.Evaluation loads project with Configuration/Platform globals; ClCompile/ClInclude evaluated metadata yields file forced includes, extra include directories, definitions; first duplicate full path wins with OrdinalIgnoreCase; UnloadProject in finally.
Per-file makefile lookup overrides forced includes, directories and preprocessor definitions; exceptions logged and caught.
Sanitize cache key combines include text, project directory and relative-path flag; cache-generation check controls admission.
Evaluated rule CompileAs distinguishes C/C++; non-C LanguageStandard maps14/17/20/latest99; AdditionalOptions can override standard.
